_comment: DESIGN PHILOSOPHY & SYSTEM RULES: Lean and modular keyword system. Alchemy relies on material, elemental, and physical transmutation. Specific locomotion (climbing, swimming, burrowing) and mental effects emerge from combining base keywords rather than bloating the pool with niche tags. High-tier effects use keyword duplication or advanced combinations within the 4-slot recipe limit.

Fire.description: Thermal energy, combustion, and intense heat.

Water.description: Fluidity, ocean depths, and aquatic currents.

Radiant.description: Luminescence, divine illumination, and holy energy.

Life.description: Restorative biological energy and physical healing.

Creature.description: Origin essences from specific creature taxonomies.

Traversal.description: Kinetic acceleration and stride enhancement. Specialized movement (climbing, swimming, burrowing) is achieved via elemental combinations.

Spatial.description: Short-range spatial displacement progressing to full phase-shifting.

Force.description: Kinetic impact, kinetic barriers, and concentrated pressure.

Protection.description: Warding, damage mitigation, and defensive reinforcement.

Mind.description: Cognitive enhancement, sensory perception, languages, telepathy, and mental restoration.

Transformation.description: Polymorph, physical shape-shifting, and structural adaptation.

Arcane.description: Gated high-tier magic catalyst. Synthesized via intermediate crafts.

Vorpal.description: Mythic sharpness and spatial severing. Unlocked via high-tier intermediate combinations.

scalingByRarity.Legendary / Story Item: 9 required keywords (maximum for narrative-specific ultimate crafts)

recipeCapacityRules.rationale: High-level recipes require up to 8 keywords (9 for narrative story items). Because 4 raw reagents contribute mixed keywords that rarely align to specific targets, players MUST use distilled Intermediate Catalysts to hit high keyword densities.
